answer.reason: The verses in Ruth tell of Boaz's kindness to Ruth, his redemption of Elimelech's land and his marriage to her.

clauses.english: let Ruth glean in his field and commanded his young men not to reproach her
clauses.quote: Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not

clauses.english: bought Elimelech's land from Naomi when the nearer kinsman gave up his right to redeem it
clauses.quote: Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's

clauses.english: took Ruth the Moabitess as his wife, and she bore a son
clauses.quote: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife

doubts: The first clause joins his words to Ruth with his order to his young men; both are one kindness to her in the harvest field.
